missionGoal: Produce a complete navigable and self-contained mathematical JSON program for the real dense unquantized Gemma 4 Safetensors package. It must embed every required learned weight, bias, scale and constant losslessly; expose every dependency-ordered operation, intermediate value and producer/consumer coordinate; substitute addressable learned operands with exact decoded numeric literals in its scalar audit view; declare dtype bits, casts, rounding and reduction semantics; replay forward and greedy generation while the source checkpoint is physically unavailable; and match an authoritative Gemma runtime at the claimed fidelity. Work exclusively on Gemma 4 and the architecture, Clean Code, SOLID design, tests, documentation and fail-closed validation directly required to complete and prove this artifact.

requiredEvidence: self-contained literal artifact with every learned value embedded
complete ordered and navigable mathematical program

missionGates.description: The real dense unquantized Gemma 4 source has an immutable revision and checksums
The JSON embeds every required learned value and can be consumed without the source checkpoint
All forward and greedy-generation operations, intermediates and state transitions are dependency ordered and navigable
Scalar audit formulas substitute addressable weights, biases, scales and constants with exact decoded numeric literals
Dtypes, bit patterns, casts, rounding boundaries, index domains and reduction order are explicit and reproducible
Forward and greedy generation replay successfully while the source checkpoint is physically unavailable
Intermediate values, logits, cache and generated tokens match an authoritative Gemma runtime at the declared fidelity
A reader can follow exact inputs, producer outputs, consumer coordinates and layer transitions step by step
The implementation applies cohesive architecture, Clean Code, SOLID, independent tests and maintainable documentation
Unknown or unproven Gemma semantics are rejected rather than guessed or approximated silently
